title: Scoped proof: Gaussian whole-hyperplane reciprocity costs at least 180
body:
## Result and scope

All **3600 ordered whole-hyperplane rectangles** on the fixed60 Gaussian E8 lines are allowed, including the2640 nonorthogonal-normal types excluded by PR767. If the **fitted binary matrix B is symmetric**, any finite scalar binary decomposition pays at least **180 Gaussian pairing-rank units /360 rational units**. Individual totals may be asymmetric and arbitrary repetitions are allowed. A fitting B with just one asymmetric unordered pair still costs at least66 Gaussian units.

The structural proof is invertible characteristic-two congruence: O is the symmetric rank60 hyperplane incidence with O1=1; Q=O^-1; X=QBQ^T. Symmetric B gives diag(X)=Q diag(B)=1, forcing all60 rank3 diagonal types. The conditional fully favorable Dfc budgets are -120-240s and -120-12s, respectively, so these classes cannot give positive saving even with every additional expense granted free. **No new supplier or kappa; no sharpness at180 or unrestricted cost lower bound is claimed.**

For arbitrary fitted B, the new defect formula is diag(X)=1 XOR sum_e (B_ij XOR B_ji)(Q_i AND Q_j), over450 unordered orthogonal edges. Its exact image has rank59 and consists of **all even-weight vectors**. A genuine34-edge nonsymmetric fitting witness has no diagonal types and bill4736, showing why the forced-diagonal implication cannot be extended to all completions. It is a scope-boundary control, not a cheap construction.

## Evidence and reproduction

Adds only research/gaussian-hyperplane-allpairs/: README proof, complete SELECTION, TASK, source pins, registered VERIFY, exact RESULT and standard-library verifier. Checks cover3600 physical pairing ranks,900 directed fitting generators,62 separately realified rational ranks, complete diagonal-image basis, literal rectangle replay, and11 semantic controls. Checks remain active under -O.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/gaussian-hyperplane-allpairs/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-hyperplane-allpairs
```

Observed locally on macOS arm64 / CPython3.12.12: optimized --write smoke PASS and registered replay PASS, with pairs=3600 symmetric_floor=180 single_asymmetry_floor=66 diagonal_image_rank=59 zero_diagonal_bill=4736 controls=11 no_new_kappa. The parent independently reviewed the proof and replayed the registered package before granting publication. No GitHub CI, Lean/kernel run, selected cold replay or full repository suite is claimed.
